Functional description

The relay J20 controls the compressor engagment circuit.

The relay is supplied by relay R1 : line controlled by the ignition INT/A, protected by fuse F15 : both are housed in the junction unit B1 .

The supply for the relay R1 comes from the direct line of the maxifuse J/B1 of B5, whilst the coil is supplied by the ignition-operated line (INT/A): this line also supplies the control switch in unit H81 . via fuse B27 .

The relay J20 coil is supplied by the line protected by fuse B36 and the main relay J10E5030 .

Press the appropriate button on unit H81 to sends a signal to 4-stage pressure switch K10: This, in turn, if the pressure in the circuit is correct, does not interrupt the signal which reaches the engine control unit M10 (pin 48 of connector A).

Control unit M10 uses its own internal software to also sends a signal (from pin 41of connector A) to activate the compressor which energizes the relay J20.

The relay operates the solenoid valve, at 12 V, which switches on the air conditioning compressor L20 .

The fan N85 operates at the first speed if the button for engaging the compressor is pressed, except if the control knob H81 is in position '0' See E6020 AIR CONDITIONING .
